claims.statement: For a physical partition J union K of an orthonormal two-frame V, with G=V_J^T V_J, H=V_K^T V_K=I-G, bankwise least-squares coefficients c_J,c_K, residual distances e_J,e_K, beta=dist(b,range(V)), and delta=c_J-c_K, beta^2=e_J^2+e_K^2+delta^T G H delta exactly.

In the inherited thin-puncture state s2(D)>=s0 L, s3(D)<L/4096, for every fixed eta>0 either a literal cross-star third-compound gives ||p_Q||inf<=6^(4/3)s0^(-2/3)eta^(-1/3)/L with p_Q in C0, or both cross-star distances are <eta L; in the latter branch either ||c_J-c_K||>sqrt(3) beta or beta<=2(1+q*)sqrt(2)eta L+2q*||b||, q*=1/(4096 s0).

At eta=2^-20 and inherited ||b||>rho_* L, rho_*=0.0006247538095703261, the payment constant is <2369.566/L; otherwise either ||c_J-c_K||>sqrt(3) beta or beta/||b||<0.005848651. If the mismatch branch occurs while the ultra-alignment branch fails, ||c_J-c_K||>6.328856e-6 L.

On the same inherited distributed-star survivor, fleet04/B08 r3 gives sup_t P(|Q-t|<eps)<=4*2^(1/4)*sqrt(eps/||b||)<190.311 sqrt(eps/L), retaining the entire child quadratic term. This is a square-root small-ball bound, not a density bound by itself.
